arxiv-2210-07569.title: Theory of Energy Dispersion of Chiral Phonons
arxiv-2210-07569.creator: Hirokazu Tsunetsugu 1 and Hiroaki Kusunose 1,2
arxiv-2210-07569.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hirokazu Tsunetsugu 1 and Hiroaki Kusunose 1,2. We have developed a microscopic theory on phonon energy dispersion in chiral crystals within a harmonic approximation. One of the main issues is about the splitting of sound velocity of acoustic phonons with opposite “crystal” angular momenta. We have shown that the splitting must be zero even in chiral crystals and the difference starts from the order of at least k 2 k^{2} or higher in their energy dispersion.

arxiv-2310-18685.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sandeep Kumar † \dagger, Tirthankar Ghosal ‡ \ddagger, Asif Ekbal † \dagger. arxiv-2502-07978.title: A Survey of In-Context Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2502-07978.creator: Amir Moeini, Jiuqi Wang, Jacob Beck, Ethan Blaser, Shimon Whiteson, Rohan Chandra, Shangtong Zhang
arxiv-2502-07978.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) agents typically optimize their policies by performing expensive backward passes to update their network parameters. However, some agents can solve new tasks without updating any parameters by simply conditioning on additional context such as their action-observation histories. This paper surveys work on such behavior, known as in-context reinforcement learning.

uslaw-usc-t14-s527.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 5 (Functions And Powers); Subchapter II (Life Saving And Law Enforcement Authorities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
